skill_name: List five components of a disaster recovery plan
workflow: The five components of a disaster recovery plan are risk assessment and planning, data/application/system backups, emergency power, disaster notification/communication, and data storage redundancy. Risk assessment and planning involves identifying and mitigating potential risks such as natural disasters or power outages.
